about: Which industry sectors each full committee oversees, for the committee-conflict stock-trading rule. Draft (placeholder): needs review before trading deductions are published. Keys are congress-legislators committee IDs (see public/committees.json); sector names are those in public/sectors.js. A subcommittee member counts under the full committee. Committees whose work spans the whole economy or none of it (Appropriations, Budget, Rules, Ethics, Foreign Affairs, Judiciary, Oversight, Intelligence and others) are left out, so they create no conflicts.
